name: dw
description: AI-native SDLC workflow for GitHub: issue (or local item) -> design grilling -> approved plan -> test-first -> implement -> simplify -> test -> fresh review -> gated commit, PR and issue writes. Small orchestrator context, heavy work in subagents, rules in hooks, stack-agnostic repo profiles.

research_root.title: Research root
research_root.description: Folder for per-item working folders (<id>-<slug>). Keep it outside the main checkout (Claude Code blocks edits there from a worktree session). Empty = <parent of main checkout>/<repo family>-research, where family is the checkout folder name up to the first '.'.

protected_branches.title: Protected branches
protected_branches.description: Comma-separated branch globs where Edit/Write is blocked (git-ignored files excepted).

branch_template.title: Branch template
branch_template.description: Item branch name. Placeholders: {prefix} (fix for a bug, else feature), {id} (issue number or local-<n>), {slug}.

worktree_root.title: Worktree root
worktree_root.description: Folder for item worktrees. Empty = <parent of main checkout>/<repo>-worktrees.

type_labels.title: Issue type labels
type_labels.description: Maps GitHub labels to dw item types: type=label|label;... Types: bug (investigate), feature (scope), epic (split), task (deliver). No match: dw asks.

github_mcp_servers.title: GitHub MCP servers
github_mcp_servers.description: Comma-separated MCP server names gated as GitHub (exact name, or a plugin server ending in _<name>). A name other than github also needs adding to the hooks.json matcher.

usage_auto_refresh.title: Auto-refresh usage stats
usage_auto_refresh.description: At session end (and /clear) refresh usage.md/usage.json of the item bound to the worktree and the usage dashboard. Reads local transcripts only; no tokens used.
